import subprocess, sys

# Test R1: pysemver without arguments should raise SystemExit (not AttributeError)
result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'semver'], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(f"bare pysemver: exit={result.returncode}, stderr={result.stderr[:200]!r}")

# Test R1: pysemver bump without specific args should print help and exit gracefully
result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'semver', 'bump'], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(f"pysemver bump: exit={result.returncode}, stdout={result.stdout[:200]!r}")
